causes.what: Core router has a sudden interface error storm (about 400 errors/s versus under 1 normally) that causes 27-41% packet loss on every host behind it, including both distribution switches and everything downstream.

evidence: core-rtr-01 if.errors.rate was under 1 until 15:00:59, then jumped to 422 at 15:01:59 and stayed at about 360-433 through 15:06:59.
Ping loss alerts opened on 19 hosts between 15:02:58 and 15:03:55, about 1-2 minutes after the router errors began.
Current ICMP loss is 28-41% on all hosts (lb-01 41%, db-01 40%, nas-01 38%, web-03 38%, dist-sw-02 32%, dist-sw-01 28%, hv-02 36%), which is a network-wide pattern.
dist-sw-01 and dist-sw-02 interface errors are about 0.6-0.9 and their uplink status is up, so the fault sits at the router, not the switches.
Application and storage metrics look normal: db-01 repl lag 2s, io wait 7%, nas latency 3.1ms, lb backends healthy 4, app db errors 0.
The app-01 and web-03 'Unavailable by ICMP' alerts (app-01 resolved) are just ping-loss flaps and are symptoms.
